intent.statement: Implement the Narrator Voice Single-Document Implementation Plan: replace fragmented narrator persistence with one strict authoritative narrator_voice.json document, canonical per-profile WAV ownership, selection by profile id, atomic AI resume state, updated downstream consumers, lifecycle/reset/export behavior, tests, requirements, and documentation, with no legacy reader or migration.

examples: A fresh project creates the exact default narrator_voice.json and no removed narrator artifact.
A document with an unknown root field or invalid selected_profile_id is rejected without being overwritten.
spec_items.statement: The Narrator Voice loader and writer shall accept only the exact seven-field narrator_voice.json root contract with valid nested profile, sample, usage, budget, selection, status, and resume relationships; initialize only a missing document; and preserve malformed current files while raising a dedicated contract error.

examples: Renaming a sampled profile preserves audio_narator_<profile_id>.wav.
Selecting a sampled profile changes narrator_voice.json but creates no narator.wav or narator_sample.json.
spec_items.statement: Every profile and sample mutation shall atomically update the authoritative document and canonical profile-id WAV, while narrator selection changes only selected_profile_id and never copies JSON metadata or WAV bytes.

examples: A matching retry skips completed style windows even when it opens a new diagnostic log.
An invalid final response leaves the existing profile inventory unchanged and retains resumable state.
spec_items.statement: AI narrator generation shall checkpoint deterministic resume identity, allocation, complete style observations, cumulative usage, budget, and instructions in narrator_voice.json; cancellation or failure shall preserve profiles and resume; and success shall atomically append all validated profiles, set completed, and clear resume.

examples: Audio Blocks uses the selected profile-owned WAV and sample transcript.
Character Voices same-narrator synchronization uses the selected canonical narrator WAV without reading selected-copy artifacts.
spec_items.statement: All selected-narrator consumers shall resolve the selected profile metadata, language, and canonical WAV through narrator_definition_service at read time and shall report not-ready when either current metadata or the canonical WAV is missing.

examples: Narrator Voice export includes narrator_voice.json and valid per-profile samples.
Preserving narrator_definition keeps the authoritative document, profile WAVs, and narrator AI logs.
spec_items.statement: Project completion healing, exports, snapshots, reset, and preservation shall use narrator_voice.json and canonical profile WAVs, exclude narrator AI logs from snapshots, clean the actual narrator_profiles log pattern only in narrator reset scope, and never inspect or delete removed-contract artifacts.

examples: Generating or importing a sample for the selected profile requires no selection refresh and leaves the visible workflow unchanged.
spec_items.statement: The persistence replacement shall preserve the visible Narrator Voice workflow, profile prompt and preview validation, language and gender-allocation behavior, VoiceWeaver contracts, and compact narrator fields in project.json while removing selected-copy refresh operations from the controller.
